encounter.title: Combat pressure 1 — a real puzzle-shot
encounter.notes: User-fixed board and placement, do not change (docs/COMBAT-RULES.md 10, encounter 1). tiny 4x5, 4 arrows: N=1 E=1 S=2 W=0. Only arrow #0 (E) is free at start; the single N arrow #2 is blocked by #0. Intended sequence: turn 1 taps #0 (E, misses the mob -- a pure puzzle move that frees #2), turn 2 taps #2 (N, kills). This is deliberate: the first encounter should already show the game stays a puzzle, not 'tap the one free arrow and the round ends'. No player-HP consequence yet: blockedTapDamage 0, no attackTimer.
